description: Check whether IBANs are structurally valid - length, country and checksum - without resolving the bank behind them. Use it when the question is only 'is this typed correctly'; use analyze_iban when the answer has to name a bank, because this tool never will. Takes up to 50 in one call and returns a separate verdict for each, so an invalid entry never fails the rest. Requires an X-Api-Key header, and costs one validation from the caller's monthly allowance however many IBANs the call carried.

ibans.description: The IBANs, exactly as they were written down. Spaces, lower case and the grouped form a bank prints on a statement are all accepted, so nothing needs normalising first. Up to 50 in one array, and sending the whole list in a single call costs the same as sending one IBAN. Each entry is answered on its own, so a malformed one comes back marked invalid beside the others rather than failing the call.

name: validate_iban
title: Check IBANs are well formed
